title: Output Schema for Send Reply Operation
description: Output schema for the Solace sendReply operation.

payload.description: The main response payload from the sendReply operation.

sent.description: Whether the reply was sent successfully.

replyTo.description: The name of the reply-to destination the reply was sent to.

deliveryMode.description: The delivery mode used for the reply (e.g., DIRECT, PERSISTENT, NON_PERSISTENT).

messageType.description: The message type used for the reply (e.g., TEXT, BYTES, XML).

correlationId.description: The correlation id carried over from the inbound request message. Present only when the request carried a correlation id.

repliedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the reply was sent.

sent.description: Whether the reply was sent successfully.

replyTo.description: The name of the reply-to destination the reply was sent to.

deliveryMode.description: The delivery mode used for the reply (e.g., DIRECT, PERSISTENT, NON_PERSISTENT).

correlationId.description: The correlation id carried over from the inbound request message. Present only when the request carried a correlation id.

outcome.description: UNKNOWN when the deadline, an interrupt or a transport failure cut the operation off after the send was entered. The reply may or may not have reached the broker, so a retry is at least once. Absent otherwise.

headers.description: Transport headers associated with the response.
